summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Lead Scoring Rules system. Backend APIs pass all tests (18/18). Frontend UI is fully functional with one bug fixed (SelectItem empty value error). Scoring endpoint was fixed to support UUID-based lead IDs.
passed_tests: Lead Scoring Settings page loads at /settings/developer/lead-scoring
Stats cards show total rules (21), active rules (19), scored property leads (1), scored buyer leads (0)
Tabs switch between 'Property / Seller Leads' and 'Buyer Leads'
Rules are grouped by category with collapsible sections (Contact Information, Value Information, Property Details, etc.)
Each rule shows name, description, conditions, points, AI verification icon (sparkle)
Toggle switch enables/disables rules (verified state change)
Create Rule button opens modal with form
Create Rule modal has all fields: name, description, category, points, conditions, active toggle, AI verify toggle, priority
Edit button opens pre-filled modal for existing rule
Cancel button closes modal without saving
Backend API: GET /api/lead-scoring/rules returns rules list
Backend API: GET /api/lead-scoring/rules?lead_type=property_seller filters correctly
Backend API: GET /api/lead-scoring/rules?lead_type=buyer filters correctly
Backend API: GET /api/lead-scoring/rules?category=contact_info filters correctly
Backend API: POST /api/lead-scoring/rules creates new rule
Backend API: GET /api/lead-scoring/rules/{id} returns single rule
Backend API: PUT /api/lead-scoring/rules/{id} updates rule
Backend API: POST /api/lead-scoring/rules/{id}/toggle toggles active status
Backend API: DELETE /api/lead-scoring/rules/{id} deletes rule
Backend API: GET /api/lead-scoring/fields returns field definitions for property_seller and buyer
Backend API: GET /api/lead-scoring/operators returns operator definitions
Backend API: GET /api/lead-scoring/stats returns statistics
Backend API: POST /api/lead-scoring/score/property-lead/{id} scores a property lead
Backend API: Validation returns 400 for invalid rule ID
Backend API: Returns 404 for nonexistent rule
Backend API: Returns 422 for missing required fields
Backend API: Returns 401/403 for unauthenticated requests

bugs_fixed.issue: SelectItem with empty string value causing runtime error when opening Create Rule modal
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed value='' to value='__placeholder__' for the disabled placeholder SelectItem

bugs_fixed.issue: Scoring endpoints expected MongoDB ObjectId but property leads use UUID
bugs_fixed.fix: Updated score_property_lead and score_buyer_lead endpoints to lookup by 'id' field first, with ObjectId fallback

seed_data_creation: 21 default scoring rules were already seeded (12 property_seller, 9 buyer). 1 property lead was scored during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lead Scoring Rules system is fully functional. 21 rules exist (12 for property/seller leads, 9 for buyer leads). The scoring endpoint now supports UUID-based lead IDs. One property lead has been scored with a 'poor' rating (7.4%) due to missing data fields. The Create Rule modal bug has been fixed.

features_verified.tab_switching: Working - Property/Seller Leads and Buyer Leads tabs
features_verified.rule_display: Working - name, description, conditions, points, AI icon
